text: [Frank & Freedus v. Allstate Ins. Co., supra, 45 CA4th at 470, 52 CR2d at 683] 2) [3:382] “In any other capacity”: Although the phrase “employer or in an any other capacity” may be ambiguous, other language in the exclusion makes clear that the employment-related practices liability exclusion relates primarily to “claims that could only arise in situations of employment, former employment, or prospective employment.” [North American Bldg. Maint., Inc. v. Fireman's Fund Ins. Co., supra, 137 CA4th at 642, 40 CR3d at 479] a) [3:383] Effect: Thus, the exclusion should not limit coverage for the insured's business operations outside of its internal employment practices. [North American Bldg. Maint., Inc. v. Fireman's Fund Ins. Co., supra, 137 CA4th at 642, 40 CR3d at 479—employment-related practices exclusion did not apply to action brought by employees of another entity] [3:384 - 3:389] Reserved. (b) [3:390] Applicable to post-termination torts?
